messages:
Sam: Quick check — aya-mini-v0 onboarding: weights are uploaded but a tokenizer mismatch popped up in the smoke test. Anyone available for a quick tokenizer quirk sync?

Nina: I ran a couple of sample prompts, hitting an extra token at the start intermittently. Looks like a zero-width joiner (ZWJ, \u200d) is being tokenized as its own token in our v3 tokenizer.

Leo: Which tokenizer build are we using on the canary? v2 or v3?

Sam: v3. Serve logs show a prefix validation error: `prefix_length != model.config.prefix_len`. The model weights expect a 3-token prefix, but our detected prefix is 4 because ZWJ became its own token.

Maria: Can you paste the exact error snippet?

Sam: ```
serve: ERROR prefix validation failed: expected 3 got 4
model.config.prefix_len=3
detected_prefix_tokens=[50256, 431, 12, 226]  # ZWJ became token at front
```

Nina: Ah — the onboarding prompt set used ZWJ as a role delimiter between system/user. Older tokenizer collapsed it; v3 preserves it. Quick mitigation: normalize prompts to remove ZWJ or map it to a single visible sentinel token.

Leo: We should also update the config validator to flag non-printable sentinel tokens so this fails earlier in CI. For an immediate workaround add a migration rule in onboarding: `prompt_sanitize: replace('\u200d', ' ')`.

Sam: I opened PR #4822 with a small sanitize patch, but need a review. Also wondering if updating model.yaml to set `expected_prefix_tokens` to match detected tokens is acceptable?

Maria: Prefer not to bake tokenizer quirks into model metadata. Better to standardize the prompts. I'll review PR #4822.

deploy-bot: Deploy check: weights checksum OK, tokenizer build v3 passed unit tests, canary failed at 10% traffic due to prefix_len mismatch.

Nina: Proposed plan: (1) remove ZWJ from chat templates, (2) add config validator check for non-printable tokens, (3) add a unit test that ensures sentinel mappings are consistent across tokenizer builds. Can we land (1) today?

Leo: I can land (1) but will also add a short note in the SDK docs warning about invisible delimiters. Will coordinate the docs PR.

Sam: Thanks. Maria, once you approve I'll queue a quick canary run. Also cc eng-runtime in case any kernel/caching assumptions depend on prefix_len indexing.

Maria: Approved the PR. Quick reminder: include a changelog entry and a note for Private deployments that might have pinned tokenizer builds.

Sam: :thumbsup: I'll queue the canary after the changelog.

Nina: Follow-up: adding a lightweight CI check that tokenizes a canonical prompt and asserts length == model.config.prefix_len should catch regressions. I'll open that.

Leo: Good call. Also adding a short repro snippet for the oncall runbook:
```
# repro
from tokenizer import tokenize
p = '\\u200dSYSTEM\\u200dHello'
print(tokenize(p))
```

Sam: Perfect. Thanks all — will post canary results in this thread.
